outcome: Newborn congenital heart defects (ostium secundum atrial septal defect, patent foramen ovale)
cohort: Pregnant women with congenital heart disease who delivered in a tertiary care hospital after twenty-eight weeks of gestation during a three-year period.
finding: Maternal and perinatal outcomes are favourable in women with treated congenital heart disease, but maternal mortality remains high in women with Eisenmenger Syndrome.
